description: A private residence on Parker Island in British Columbia's Southern Gulf Islands, reached by boat from Montague Harbour. The Parker Island Residence was among the projects featured on the studio's original website.

Like much of the firm's coastal work, the house belongs to its shoreline setting of forest and rocky foreshore — designed around the water view, with the landscape's own materials carried through the architecture.
note: Photography for this project has not yet been recovered from the archives.
